zh: 中部横貫公路太魯閣段，鑿山鑽洞蜿蜒於深浚峽谷間，沿河谷開路工程艱鉅，途中險象環生，構成绝景處處，奇觀無數。此圖以膠彩畫表現一斧一鑿的痕迹，隧道曲折，時隱時現。
en: The Taroko section of the Central Cross-Island Highway, cut through mountains and bored through tunnels, winds among deep gorges; the roadbuilding along the river valley was an arduous feat of engineering, fraught with peril along the way, yielding breathtaking scenery at every turn and countless wonders. This piece renders in gouache the marks of every axe-stroke and chisel-cut, the tunnels twisting, now hidden, now revealed.

zh: 立霧溪涓涓细流的心事
“ 你願意為這美麗的島嶼
開鑿一條壯麗的峽谷嗎 ？"
en: A voice from antiquity calls out in question
The trickling heart's concerns of the Liwu River
"Are you willing, for this beautiful island
carve out a magnificent canyon?"
The Liwu River answered:
I am willing!

zh: 於是大地震盪，山河歡暢
en: And so the earth trembles, mountains and rivers rejoice

zh: 塔次基溪，波浪溪，凱金溪
陶塞溪，托博開溪，比林溪，魯丹溪
休督溪，西喀拉溪，古白楊溪
慈恩溪，互黑爾溪，小互黑爾溪
大沙溪，沙卡檔溪，老西溪……
湍湍急急， 奔流滙集
en: And so
Tacheji Creek, Bolang Creek, Kaijin Creek
Tosai Stream, Toboqi Stream, Bilin Stream, Ludan Stream
Xiudu Creek, Xikala Creek, Gubaiyang Creek
Ci'en Stream, Huhei'er Stream, Little Huhei'er Stream
Dasha Creek, Shakadang Creek, Laoxi Creek……
Swift and urgent, rushing waters converge

zh: 帕托魯山，佐久間山，立霧主山
奇萊山，合歡山，石門山，畢祿山
雞鳴山，瓏奧山，平頭山，南湖大山
袋角山，盤石山，黑岩山，加卑山
南神山，曉星山，三池山，太魯閣山
en: And so
Mount Paturu, Mount Sakuma, Lihwu Main Peak
Qilai Mountain, Hehuan Mountain, Shimen Mountain, Bilu Mountain
Jiming Mountain, Long'ao Mountain, Pingtou Mountain, Nanhu Dashan
Daijiao Mountain, Panshi Mountain, Heiyan Mountain, Jiabei Mountain
Nanshen Mountain, Xiaoxing Mountain, Sanchi Mountain, Taroko Mountain
Qingshui Mountain, Arashiyama………
Giving way one after another, bowing heads to shelter
And so
The stream surges on, the gorge cut deep
Sheer cliffs rise, river terraces climb
The marble surface worn fine and delicate
Every line of muscle and bone laid bare
The magnificent Taroko Gorge
And thus it takes form
Bike along the creek
The mountain wind rises from the valley floor
There is a song murmuring like a stream -----
"Longing for the image of home back then
Rivers and mountains the moonlight falls upon from time to time
That mountain there, that stream there
forever holding on to our dream”

points.zh: 台灣文獻會在1951年議定的台灣八景: 玉山積雪，安平夕照，阿里雲海，清水㫁崖，雙潭秋月，魯谷幽峽，大屯春色，澎湖漁火。其中的魯谷幽峽，就是立霧溪經年累月浸蝕切割形成的太魯閣峽谷。
立霧溪發源於海抜3000公尺的中央山脈，在奇萊北峰與合歡山之間，流經55公里後注入太平洋。其山群支流多集中在上游區域。立霧溪河水湍急，下切浚深，落差甚大，在天祥至錦文橋一段，切割出落差1660公尺的錐麓大斷崖，絕岩峭壁，天光一線，氣勢磅礴，散發著天地悠悠的蒼茫。
points.en: The Liwu River originates at an elevation of 3,000 meters in the Central Mountain Range, between Qilai North Peak and Hehuan Mountain, and after flowing 55 kilometers empties into the Pacific Ocean; most of its mountainous tributaries are concentrated in its upper reaches. The Liwu River's waters run swift and have cut deep, with a great drop in elevation; between Tianxiang and Jinwen Bridge, it has carved out the Zhuilu Grand Cliff, with a drop of 1,660 meters — sheer cliffs and precipices, a thin sliver of sky visible above, magnificent and awe-inspiring, exuding the boundless, timeless vastness of heaven and earth.

points.zh: 立霧溪名稱的由來，源於位在溪口北岸的太魯閣原住民崇德部落，崇德原名得其黎 (Takkiri) 社，日治時期譯爲日語漢字 "立霧"，以後沿用立霧溪迄今。
points.en: The name of the Liwu River comes from the Truku indigenous settlement of Chongde, located on the river's north bank at its mouth. The settlement's original name was Takkiri; during the Japanese colonial era it was rendered in Japanese kanji as "Tatsukiri" (Liwu), and this name has since been used for the Liwu River.

points.zh: 立霧溪河口曾是砂金產地，據歷史記載，17世纪時葡萄牙人就曾在立霧溪河口發現砂金，後期亦有漢人在此探勘金脈。花蓮的古地名：哆囉滿，據知就是指立霧溪河口的砂金。
points.en: The mouth of the Liwu River was once a source of placer gold. Historical records show that as early as the 17th century, the Portuguese discovered placer gold at the mouth of the Liwu River, and later Han Chinese also prospected for gold veins there. The old place-name of Hualien, "Turumoan," is known to refer to the placer gold at the mouth of the Liwu River.
The lyrics are taken from 'My Hometown at Dusk.'
